name: CIC Core Paperwork Bank
description: Sheets come in families - kinds of paperwork, each more or less unrelated to whatever the visitor came about. Topics are the things each family wants to know, each asked many ways. A wording is never shown twice to the same visitor; topics keep coming back.

sum: a sum to be determined by {{officer}}

families.name: Grievance & Casus Belli
titles: Declaration of Hostile Intent — Continuation Sheet
Notice of Intent to Continue Intending
Claim for Emotional Damage to a Corporation
instructions: **Please note:** the Concern is a pacifist commercial entity and does not make war. This form concerns war. It has been issued anyway.
**Procedural note:** your matter has been classified as a potential declaration of hostilities. The classification is routine and is applied to all matters, including compliments.
**Attention:** the Office does not accept spoken declarations, broadcasts, or strongly worded signage. Those are not filings. They are kept without being read.
sectionNotes: The Concern does not make war. This section is completed regardless.
This section was added in response to a previous filing and may not apply to you. Complete it regardless.

families.name: Customer Satisfaction & Returns
instructions: **Your feedback matters.** It is weighed, catalogued, and stored at a constant temperature.
**Please note:** this survey is voluntary. Completion of this survey is mandatory.
sectionNotes: Answers in this section will be used to improve our service, which is already optimal.
Vouchers issued under this section are redeemable against future forms.

families.name: Shipyard Services & Hull Registration
instructions: **Before you begin:** vessels must be registered before they are built, and built before they are registered.
**Please note:** the Concern builds ships for any purpose except war, and does not ask what the purpose is.
sectionNotes: Measurements in this section should be given in blocks. Blocks should be given in measurements.
Vessels registered under this section are not guaranteed to fly.

families.name: Cargo, Customs & Logistics
instructions: **Before you begin:** all cargo must be declared, including cargo that has not yet been lost.
**Please note:** the Concern delivers anywhere and discloses nothing, including, on occasion, the delivery.
sectionNotes: Places in this section must be described in words. The Office does not accept coordinates.
Containers declared empty will be inspected for emptiness.

families.name: Mining Permits & Resource Claims
instructions: **Before you begin:** a permit is required to mine. A permit is also required to apply for a permit.
**Please note:** the Concern purchases all ore at a fair price, which it sets.
sectionNotes: Quantities in this section are recorded as reported and paid as measured.
Holes declared in this section remain the declarant’s responsibility.

families.name: Personnel & Crew Welfare
instructions: **Your wellbeing is important to the Concern.** It appears as a line item in the quarterly accounts.
**Please note:** this form concerns your crew. You are not the Concern’s crew. Complete it regardless.
sectionNotes: Welfare concerns raised in this section will be addressed in the order they are filed, which is last.
Oxygen is provided at cost.

families.name: Insurance & Damage Claims
instructions: **Before you begin:** claims must be filed before the damage occurs, or within a reasonable time afterwards, as determined before the damage occurs.
**Please note:** you do not hold a policy with the Concern. This claim will be processed regardless.
sectionNotes: Damage caused by the laws of physics is excluded.
Estimates in this section will be reduced by a fixed percentage, and then by another.

instructions: **Before you begin:** this sheet must be completed in full before the matter it concerns can be considered to exist. Incomplete sheets are not rejected — they are filed alongside complete ones, in the same drawer, in no particular order.
**Notice:** answers given on this sheet may contradict answers given on a previous sheet. Where they do, both are kept and neither is preferred.
**Important:** do not leave any field blank. A blank field is read by {{officer}} as an admission, though of what has not been determined.
**Please note:** the Concern is a pacifist commercial entity and will not respond to this filing with force. It will respond with correspondence, which is worse.
**Before proceeding:** confirm that you have read Form {{form}}. You have not. Confirm it anyway.
**Filers are reminded** that the Concern knows where every faction in this sector is and discloses none of them, including yours, including to you.
**Warning:** completing this sheet does not advance your matter. Nothing advances your matter. Your matter is stationary by design.
**Procedural note:** some information requested below has been requested before. The Office requires it again, in the form now asked.
**Guidance:** where a question resembles one you have already answered, answer it as though you had not.
**Routing note:** this sheet may have been issued by the wrong department. It must be completed regardless, and returned to the right one.

finePrint: By filing, the declaring party acknowledges that this form does not constitute acceptance, rejection, or acknowledgement of any grievance, hostility, or correspondence, and may generate further forms.
Filing creates no obligation on the part of the Concern, and no right on the part of the declaring party, other than the right to file again.
The Concern is a pacifist commercial entity. Nothing in this form should be read as a threat, a promise, or an intention to act.
Filings are kept indefinitely and reviewed at the Office’s convenience, which has not yet arisen.
This form was generated automatically. It is nonetheless binding to the same extent as a form that was not, which is to say not at all.
The Office reserves the right to request this information again, on a different sheet, in different words.
Answers may be used to generate additional questions. This is the intended operation of the system, not a defect.
Neither the completion nor the abandonment of this form affects the underlying matter, which is stationary.
